# GVT2
> GVT2 provides AI-powered customer support and sales automation tools for websites, including live chat, chatbots, and lead capture.

GVT2 helps businesses automate conversations, qualify leads, and support customers through embeddable chat widgets and AI assistants.

## Main Site
- [Home](https://gvt2.com/): Overview of GVT2’s AI chat, support, and sales automation platform.
- [Pricing](https://gvt2.com/pricing): Pricing plans for AI chat, automation, and customer engagement features.
- [Contact](https://gvt2.com/contact): Contact page for sales inquiries, support, and general questions.
- [Login](https://gvt2.com/login): Sign in to access the GVT2 dashboard and account tools.
- [Sign Up](https://gvt2.com/signup): Create a new GVT2 account to start using the platform.

## Product
- [AI Chatbot](https://gvt2.com/ai-chatbot): Product page for AI chatbot capabilities and automated conversations.
- [Live Chat](https://gvt2.com/live-chat): Overview of live chat tools for real-time customer communication.
- [Lead Generation](https://gvt2.com/lead-generation): Features for capturing, qualifying, and routing website leads.
- [Customer Support](https://gvt2.com/customer-support): Support automation tools for handling customer questions and requests.
- [Sales Automation](https://gvt2.com/sales-automation): Automation features for engaging prospects and improving conversions.

## Solutions
- [For Small Business](https://gvt2.com/small-business): AI chat and support tools tailored for small business teams.
- [For Ecommerce](https://gvt2.com/ecommerce): Customer engagement and sales automation for ecommerce websites.
- [For SaaS](https://gvt2.com/saas): Chat and support workflows designed for SaaS companies.
- [For Agencies](https://gvt2.com/agencies): Multi-client chat and automation workflows for agencies and service providers.

## Guides
- [Getting Started](https://gvt2.com/docs/getting-started): Introductory guide for setting up GVT2 on a website.
- [Install Chat Widget](https://gvt2.com/docs/install-widget): Instructions for embedding the GVT2 chat widget.
- [Train Your Bot](https://gvt2.com/docs/train-bot): Guide to configuring and training the AI assistant.
- [Lead Capture Setup](https://gvt2.com/docs/lead-capture): Steps for enabling lead forms and qualification workflows.
- [Team Inbox](https://gvt2.com/docs/team-inbox): Guide to managing conversations with shared team inbox features.

## Developer
- [Developer Docs](https://gvt2.com/docs/developer): Technical documentation for developers integrating GVT2.

- [Conversations API](https://gvt2.com/api/conversations): Endpoints for managing chat conversations and message data.
- [Contacts API](https://gvt2.com/api/contacts): Endpoints for creating and updating contact and lead records.
- [Webhooks](https://gvt2.com/docs/webhooks): Webhook setup for receiving real-time event notifications.
- [JavaScript SDK](https://gvt2.com/docs/javascript-sdk): Client-side SDK usage for embedding and controlling chat behavior.
